notes.text: Turn 2 flip revealed The Sentry Drone three times (same stairwell, three copies in the floor deck?). Rulebook Setup says each floor has its own set of cards with Stairwells, and does not say a floor may hold several copies of one stairwell. Question: is that intended? Entering one; I cannot reach Oomph 8 yet.

Room 1-3 needs Scramble 5 and Gray holds Duck x2, Lock x2 (4 cards). Max I can reach is Scramble 4: every play spends hand cards as payment and there is no 5. I should have seen this before choosing the room over the others; lesson for the room choice. Fleeing without playing, Exhaust 2 each from decks, hands stay.

Regular Monster 2 has Ambush: the CLI offered only it, hiding Gears & Glitch and the Turret from my choice. Rulebook Start of Turn step 2 says choose one revealed card and does not mention Ambush. Question: is a forced entry meant to override the choose-one rule, and do the other two go to the bottom in shown order?
Regular Monster 2: Scramble 10 is out of reach (Gray max is 6 with 5 cards), Oomph 8 and Scramble 8 likewise. Fleeing without playing; Flee here is only Bad Stuff, no Exhaust.

Dark Room: Scramble 10 (printed 8, +2 from Panic) vs Gray's max 4-6. Unreachable. Fleeing for Exhaust 1 each, no Bad Stuff. Playing Panic to be rid of it would cost 2 payers plus Exhaust 2, four cards, so I keep it. Third turn of floor 2 with no clear attempt possible from Gray's hand.

Regular Monster 2 again (Ambush, forced; it went to the bottom last time and is back after 4 turns). Scramble 12 and Oomph 8 and Scramble 10 are out of reach with Panic held. Only Flee is possible. Floor 2 has now had three Flees in four turns; I took one clear (Maintenance). Question: is Ambush meant to hide a stairwell that I could otherwise enter?

Spore Cloud prompt again says 'Discard down to 3 cards' / 'choose 3 of: Overdrive, Panic, Charge, Shove, Tag Team'. Five names listed, Cloud excluded, hand 6. Card text says hold 3 including Cloud, so 3 discards. I read 'choose 3' as the discards (from the previous playtest note that the engine discards what you name). Discarding Panic, Shove, Tag Team: dropping Panic also removes its +2 Scramble. Question: is discarding a Bad Stuff card a legal way to shed it? Rulebook gives no limit.

Turn 8 flip revealed Gears & Glitch twice (first and third). Same duplicate-stairwell question as note 1. Choosing Overgrown Hydroponics Bay because its Flee is Bad Stuff only, and a Gears & Glitch Flee costs Exhaust 3 each plus Bad Stuff.

Hydroponics Bay needs Scramble 11. Gray's hand has Lock, Lock, Hack, Duck-less: even with every card played I cannot reach 11 given payments. Red has no Scramble. Fleeing; Red's deck is empty so Red lives off its discard. Both of us are only getting Bad Stuff for rooms we cannot clear.

Dark Room now reads Scramble 12 (printed 8): Gray holds Panic too, and Red's Panic is held in Red's hand as well. Two Panics show +4 total, so each held Panic adds +2 to every threshold and they stack. Rulebook has no entry for Holding effects that stack. Red's Charge is not offered: its only payer is Overdrive, Spore Cloud and Panic cannot pay. Fleeing, Exhaust 1 each.

Gray's deck is 0 and discard 1, hand 9 (six of them Bad Stuff, which cannot pay). Corrosive Acid's Turn Start Exhaust 1 will hit an empty deck soon. Playlist 13 reports that this made a player go Down with a full hand. I am scrapping Acid now by playing it (cost 3 paid with Duck, Hack, Lock) to test whether I can stay alive; the rulebook section 9 says Down is no cards in hand, deck, or discard, which Gray is not near.

Defeat on turn 12: Dark Room Flee (Exhaust 1) with Gray's deck and discard both empty and 5 cards in hand (Lock plus four Bad Stuff) printed 'Gray is Down'. Rulebook section 9 says Down is no cards in hand, deck, or discard pile; Gray held 5. Same shape as the Corrosive Acid Down in playtest 13, now from a room's Flee, so it is not Acid-specific. Question: what should Exhaust do on an empty deck and discard?
